text: {"label": "COVID-19 Pandemic Service Adaptations","definition": "Work on how behavior-analytic services responded to the COVID-19 pandemic, including rapid shifts to telehealth, clinic reopening and safety protocols, and promoting compliance with public-health preventive measures.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Defined by the COVID-19 pandemic context, unlike general telehealth delivery and training, broad clinical practice and decision-making, or long-term behavioral intervention programs."}
